role_note: The strongest honest LLM-only baseline: a per-fold MLP head trained on the same CySecBERT KG embeddings. This is NOT a rung of the canonical ladder. The canonical architecture uses the whitened-prototype consultant on every rung so the ablation is internally consistent — see results/unsw_nb15_current.json.
must_be_reported: The trained LLM head alone scores 0.8321, ABOVE the canonical full system's feedback loop at 0.7764. An MLP on CySecBERT embeddings of the KG text outperforms the complete GNN+LLM architecture on UNSW-NB15. This is a genuine weakness of the result and must appear in any report or paper alongside the ladder.
Under the head consultant the ladder does not hold at any top-k in 15-35: the loop's validation-selected best (n=20, 0.8269) sits below AGAF (0.8331) and below the head it consults (0.8321).
AGAF-head and LLM-head are separated by 0.0010 (CI [0.0000, 0.0033]) — AGAF adds essentially nothing over its own consultant.
